title: Had a dream friend give me a tour of the dream mall and now I can't remember it.
content: I was just dreaming this morning and remember visiting a new location (I believe I was to attend a friends wedding or celebration in a new city) I decided to go to the mall in that town and of course it felt familiar (but not the same as the big Fancy malls in previous dreams) probably cuz of the pictures I saw another Redditor post earlier about these abandoned malls somewhere that looked interesting. And while at the mall my dream friend and I decided to explore it floor by floor and look at all the stores. I wish I would have mapped it out right when I woke up cuz it was the first time I've ever had that sorta walkthrough/layout presented in such a consistent way. Have any of you mapped out your dreamworld malls? Anyway, happy holidays everyone! Hope y'all dreaming well.
